name: Scaled HOMER
summary: HOMER with velocity-based scaling: after selecting with a ray, slow hand movements are scaled down for precise distant manipulation.
howItWorks: The object is selected with a ray, as in HOMER, and the virtual hand jumps to it. Hand translation is then scaled by hand speed: slow movements move the object even more slowly, fast ones at equal or greater speed to recover any offset.

relationships.note: Adds velocity-based scaling to HOMER's manipulation phase.
Both scale hand motion by speed.
